name: Litti chokha
description: Wheat balls stuffed with spiced sattu, roasted on coals, served with mashed vegetables.

tcm.note: Roasted on open fire with a roasted-gram filling.

ayurveda.note: Ushna from the roasting; sattu itself is cooling.

histamine.note: The chokha is charred tomato and eggplant — both high.
